data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin providing the Add To Google Wallet Button widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to easily integrate the Add To Google Wallet feature within a Flutter application. It allows passing configuration for the pass, success/error/cancel callbacks, and locale support.
use_when: You want to allow users to add passes or loyalty cards to Google Wallet from your Flutter app.
You need a ready-made Add To Google Wallet button widget.
avoid_when: You are targeting Apple Wallet exclusively.
You do not have a Google Wallet API Issuer account set up.
strengths: Simplifies implementing the Google Wallet button.
Includes helpful callbacks for success, errors, and cancellation.
weaknesses: Requires significant prerequisites on the Google Wallet API side.
Limited to Android / Google Wallet functionality.
data.setup_notes: Requires signing up for a Google Wallet API Issuer account, authorizing the app, and creating passes classes and objects on Google's platform.

alternatives.name: wallet
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative library for wallet-related functionalities if not strictly using Google Wallet UI components.

data.minimal_example:
AddToGoogleWalletButton(
  pass: _examplePass,
  onSuccess: () => _showSnackBar(context, 'Success!'),
  onCanceled: () => _showSnackBar(context, 'Action canceled.'),
  onError: (Object error) => _showSnackBar(context, error.toString()),
)
